<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Freeze a Builder</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Freeze a Builder means to make a checker unavailable for point-making because moving it would expose or damage another feature. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
